title: lasers bounce mirrored, the tambora lifts the beams
story: Nuestra Cancion opens dark: a slam at 56 (33.3) launches the lasers from black with a colour flash, then the merengue at 129 BPM (beat 14.9 ticks, bar 59.5) starts. The tambora on each beat lifts the beams to full brightness with a small shake; the bright off-beat slaps punch the beam thickness; the guira scrapes step the palette contrast. Every two beats the lasers relaunch at a mirrored angle, and every bar the hue and the dark tint sway a little. The prominent hit at 415 (10.5) flashes the whole room.
